requested_outcome: Repair the last-minute property flow, restore useful calendar rules and prices, show every verified last-minute offer on its landing page, expose all towns missing map coordinates in administration, add regression coverage to QQQAAA, publish once, and verify the exact public release before beginning Professor.
natural_destination: The public VII last-minute landing and vacation business pages, plus the authenticated VII geography administration.
authorization_boundary: Code, tests, QQQAAA integration and public deployment are authorized. Supplier data may be read but not mutated; no bookings, leads or outbound messages may be created.

lesson_bundle.reason: The old flow is the parity reference for units and calendar information.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The new flow must preserve useful verified unit, price and minimum-stay information rather than merely render a new layout.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defects occur in interactive calendars, rails and admin filters.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Desktop, mobile, reload, retry and empty/error states are exercised across the affected family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Availability, price, minimum nights and coordinate counts are visible data contracts.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every visible value is reconciled with the supplier response or stored geography rows and no price is invented.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly rejected partial fixes and requires QQQAAA and live verification.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact deployed version must pass the complete affected journey and QQQAAA additions before completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly authorized a public release after all repairs.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: One frozen candidate, known rollback identity and post-deploy public verification are mandatory.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The selected room remains the only unit evaluated when entering from a last-minute card.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use property-wide supplier search and calendar data for all units while retaining one verified booking unit only after selection.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The Raphael Bekerem deep link evaluates all supplier room IDs and unit cards reflect property-wide availability.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The calendar shows colored dates but still omits minimum nights or a truthful price basis.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render supplier minimum-night rules and enrich the initial window with verified search totals for the matching minimum stay.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A real supplier calendar day exposes units, minimum nights and a verified minimum-stay total without fabricated nightly values.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The permanent last-minute page is still a narrow slider that hides most offers.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Give the landing a full responsive grid mode that renders every verified deal returned by the authoritative cache.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The page contains one visible card per verified deal and no slice or carousel cap.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The 24 missing points are only a number and cannot be repaired.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Expose a direct missing-coordinate filter and clearly label the entities as towns, not businesses.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The administration lists every city row missing either coordinate and each row opens in the existing editor.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Local checks pass but the public release is unchanged or another feature regresses.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze one complete candidate, run focused and broad tests, deploy once, and retest the exact live version.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public release identity, live route behavior and rollback identity are recorded; QQQAAA includes all four regressions.

sources.label: Official supplier API calendar and search contracts

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the supplier adapters and first affected public/admin slices pass focused tests, before broad styling, QQQAAA and release work.
checks: Property-wide room availability is no longer constrained by the incoming roomID.
Calendar enrichment uses documented supplier values only.
Last-minute grid and missing-coordinate admin filter render complete uncapped collections.

attack_questions: Can an incoming roomID still suppress another available unit?
Can an unavailable, closed-arrival or minimum-stay date display a misleading price?
Can the landing silently hide verified deals after the first viewport?
Does the geography count reconcile exactly with the filtered missing-coordinate rows after reload?
Did the release preserve the already completed authentication separation and all unrelated tests?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Fresh public desktop and mobile reads of /last-minute and the Raphael Bekerem business flow, plus an authenticated fresh read of /admin/geography.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused supplier/calendar/grid/geography tests, full tracked suite, QQQAAA, exact release identity and public post-deploy checks.

effectiveness.baseline: Production v657 and candidate commit 48fed79 have the four reported gaps; earlier auth fixes are prepared but not public.
effectiveness.target: One consolidated release with zero unresolved high-severity findings in the four repaired flows and no repeat publication cycle.
